page.layout: One page of text in two columns below a running head and a heading; the right column has a marginal note at the right edge ("Dominus"), and a small note beside it ("9"). Top: running head "HOMINIS" with page number 45. Then continuous text paragraphs above a centred heading "DE PATRE.", then a left column (headed XXVI, question in italic) and a right column with marginal reference notes.

main_text.p: Eph. 2. v. 18. Quoniam vtrique peripsum (Christum) habemus aditum per vnum spiritum ad patrem.
2. Corinth. 13. v. 13. Gratia Domini Iesu Christi, & charitas Dei & communicatio spiritus sancti sit cum omnibus vobis.
Galat. 4. v. 6. Quoniam autem estis filij, emisit Deus Spiritum Filij sui in corda vestra, clamantem, Abba, id est, pater.
main_text.head: DE PATRE.
XXVI.

p.i: Quid credis, cum dicis, Credo in Deum Patrem, omnipotentem, creatorem cœli & terrae?

main_text.p: Credo æternum Patrem Domini nostri Iesu Christi, qui cœlum & terrā, cum omnibus quæ in ijs sunt, ex nihilo creauit a, quique eadem æterno suo consilio & prouidentia fustē-
a Psal. 33. ver. 6. Verbo Domini cœli facti sunt & spiritu oris eius omnis exercitus eorum.
Iob. 33. v. 4. Spiritus Dei fecit me, & spiraculum omnipotentis vivificauit me. De hoc ipse vide Iob. 38. & 39 cap. Item, Psalmo 36.

page.notes: Marginal note "Dominus" at right edge beside the Psalm 33 reference; the faded word at the top right is partly illegible. The left column's final line continues onto the next page ("fustē-" runs on). Some letters in the scan are faint or damaged.
